artifact_inventory.description: Standalone numerical check of the common-delay threshold, first-mode ordering, and characteristic residual for K_p=2, K_n=1, N=20.

limitations: Scientific rejection is for originality and value, not correctness. The conclusions concern the finite linear homogeneous ring with K_p>K_n>0. Special initial histories and nonlinear or time-varying models are outside the claim.
provenance: Scientific record; fresh independent scientific assessment completed on 2026-10-01 UTC.
record_title: Exact switching geometry and no robust bounded phase in a delayed signed consensus ring
